sentences.japanese: トニーはナイフで自分の名を木に刻んだ。
sentences.english: Tony carved his name on a tree with a knife.

sentences.japanese: その彫像はさくら材の木片を刻んで作らせた。
sentences.english: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.

sentences.japanese: その彫刻家は木で仏像を刻んだ。
sentences.english: The sculptor carved wood into an image of Buddha.

sentences.japanese: その彫刻には１９２０年と刻まれている。
その像は石を刻んで作ったものだ。
sentences.english: The statue is carved out of stone.
